search_exa: search the Exa API for a query and return a list of SearchResult objects with url, title, and snippet
create_ExaResult: create an ExaResult dataclass instance with url, title, and text fields
run_search_exa: run the Exa search function with an API key, query string, result count, and optional domain filter list
review_search_exa: review the search_exa function that queries the Exa AI search API and converts results to SearchResult objects
test_search_exa: test the search_exa function with a mock API response to verify SearchResult conversion
